en_US: I feel awful about what we did...
This experiment went too far...
I’m not sure if I can stomach what
Master Cyrus plans...
Urff...
I feel too sickened to say anything...
But that thing we made...
What is it going to be used for?
There is something suspended in
a green fluid...
You’re the Champion, aren’t you?
Please, I need your help!
Before our team fell apart, we found
a fossil from a faraway land.
We brought it back to life in one of
these tanks, and we changed it.
We gave it armor and a cannon on
its back...
Last night it broke out of its tank.
It’s in the back room now.
Please, stop it before it gets out!
It’s in the back room...
Please, stop it before it gets out!
You caught it... Thank you.
It was never ours to change.
I won’t forget that.
